reuseRules: Reuse only when source bodies, consumed interfaces, synthetic inputs, clock contract and expected assertions are unchanged; tree equality alone does not prove a new native pathway.
Retain historical Node native=NOT_RUN scope; do not relabel VM results native or replay accepted #15/#18/#31 merely to populate a new report.

The 17 accepted native cases prove their named current consumer controls. Map-backed storage/reopen is not native persistence across reload, and injected JavaScript denial is not native iframe Permissions Policy.

Accepted public script/doc distribution and rollout baseline can be inherited on unchanged bytes; future doc edits need their own exact merged/public readback. Evidence publication SHA is distinct from product target SHA.
A changed provider/weather interface invalidates its affected consumer evidence; docs-only changes do not justify repeating atmospheric, terrain, motion or full-scene tests.
